persisted: SHA-256 of structural metadata and classified identifiers
never_persisted: full Provider body or stream event
API keys, Authorization headers, credentials, cookies, secret query parameters
data_minimization.content_hashing: forbidden; no digest of prompt, response text, reasoning, tool arguments, full body, or event bytes
data_minimization.unknown_strings: persist only SHA-256 of the type/class token itself, with bounded cardinality; never hash values nested under content or argument fields
data_minimization.visible_character_count: len() only; content is neither copied nor hashed

trace_guardrails.serialization: canonical JSON of metadata-only typed models
trace_guardrails.paths: absolute paths prohibited by existing trace privacy validation
trace_guardrails.failure_details: controlled failure class enum or hash of exception class name only; never exception text

streaming_rule: Observer reads only event kind, block/item kind, finish/status token, usage counters, and length of already-present text deltas; it never accumulates content for telemetry.

retention_and_authority.location: existing reliability trace root outside story project

privacy_tests: sentinel content absent from serialized observation
sentinel secret absent from observation and hashes are metadata-only
unknown type names appear only as hashes
exception message absent on persistence failure
